title: Inpatient Hospice Transitions Checklist
official: Feasibility and Adaptation of a Hospice Transitions Checklist for Hospitalized Persons With Dementia
summary: This is an NIH Stage IB single-arm feasibility study will adapt and test the Inpatient Hospice Transitions Checklist (I-HTC), an Epic-embedded intervention supporting hospice eligibility assessment and clinician-surrogate communication for hospitalized persons living with dementia.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Clinicians:

* Physicians, nurse practitioners, physician assistants, nurses, or social workers practicing in acute care
* Participate in goals-of-care, advance care planning (ACP), hospice, or care transition discussions for hospitalized adults with dementia
* Able to complete study activities in English
* Use the EPIC electronic health record (EHR) for clinical documentation and patient care

Surrogates:

* Adults aged ≥18 years
* Identified as the legally authorized representative (LAR), healthcare proxy, or next of kin
* Participate in goals-of-care, ACP, or hospice-related discussions during hospitalization
* Able to complete study communication in English

Persons Living with Dementia (PLWD):

* Adults aged ≥60 years admitted to an acute care inpatient service
* Lack decisional capacity
* Have a documented dementia diagnosis in the EHR
* Identified through the NYU Dementia EPIC Registry from the ED-LEAD trial
* Have a "No" response to the Mandatory Surprise Question: "Would you be surprised if this person were to die within the next 6 months?"
* Have clinical circumstances prompting goals-of-care or hospice-related discussions

Exclusion Criteria:

Clinicians:

* Do not routinely participate in ACP, hospice, or care transition discussions
* Decline or do not complete required study training
* Share responsibility for a patient encounter with an enrolled senior clinician

Surrogates:

* Not the primary decision-maker for the PLWD
* LAR cannot be identified or contacted to obtain informed consent
